verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs claim an 'AI code reviewer' that reviews code changes and suggests fixes, AI-powered pipeline automation, and access to Rovo AI models in terminal/IDE, which directly match the story of AI-generated insights/suggestions from data. However, these are thin, marketing-style first-party claims with no independent or hands-on corroboration of quality/accuracy. Missing for 10: independent verification of AI reviewer usefulness, deeper documentation of how insights are surfaced, and community evidence confirming real-world value.
